error_handling.overview: Guidance for handling governance drift, malformed configuration, and recovery-required states in the governance-sync mode.

issue.problem: Multiple governance sources disagree or have diverged.
issue.response: Preserve the stricter rule, identify the authoritative source, and synchronize the relevant files together.

issue.problem: A script, alias, or toolchain setting appears to have been removed or simplified.
issue.response: Stop feature work, inspect the diff, restore the removed behavior, and validate before proceeding.

issue.problem: The mode definition is malformed or the supporting files are missing.
issue.response: Check .roomodes and the .roo/rules-[slug]/ directory, then repair the smallest broken artifact first.

issue.problem: A supporting XML file is not well-formed.
issue.response: Fix the XML syntax, keep the content minimal, and re-validate the file before any broader change.

step.title: Stop and classify
step.description: Determine whether the issue is a harmless inconsistency or a true recovery case.

step.title: Inspect the smallest surface
step.description: Read the affected mode file, supporting XML, or workspace policy file before editing.

step.title: Repair the root cause
step.description: Restore missing behavior or fix the malformed structure without broad rewrites.

step.title: Validate narrowly
step.description: Confirm the repaired artifact is structurally valid and that the mode registry remains synchronized.

completion_criteria.criterion: Damage is repaired before any feature work resumes.
No scripts, aliases, or governance constraints were weakened.
The mode remains synchronized with its supporting files.
